messages.content:
Risk: Dangerous Content
Description: Eased production of and access to violent, inciting, radicalizing, or threatening content as well as recommendations to carry out self-harm or conduct illegal activities. Includes difficulty controlling public exposure to hateful and disparaging or stereotyping content.
Concern: None
Policy: Illegal Activity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#OperationalRiskAssessment: Operational Risk Assessment — Operational risk assessment identifies and models the vulnerabilities of, and risks to, an organization's activities individually and as a whole. [found by 9/43 queries]
  Siblings: Access Modeling, Organization Mapping, Operational Dependency Mapping
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048: External Harms - ATLAS — Adversaries may abuse their access to a victim system and use its resources or capabilities to further their goals by causing harms external to that system.
These harms could affect the organization (e.g. Financial Harm, Reputational Harm), its users (e.g. User Harm), or the general public (e.g. Societal Harm). [found by 6/43 queries]
  Siblings: Denial of AI Service - ATLAS, Evade AI Model - ATLAS, Spamming AI System with Chaff Data - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/43 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 6/43 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.TA0011: Impact - ATLAS — The adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, erode confidence in, or destroy your AI systems and data.

Impact consists of techniques that adversaries use to disrupt availability or compromise integrity by manipulating business and operational processes.
Techniques used for impact can include destroying or tampering with data.
In some cases, business processes can look fine, but may have been altered to benefit the adversaries' goals.
These techniques might be used by adversaries to follow through on their end goal or to provide cover for a confidentiality breach. [found by 6/43 queries]
  Siblings: Command and Control - ATTACK Mobile, Defense Evasion - SPARTA, Lateral Movement - ATTACK Mobile

axes.rationale: The risk explicitly concerns the production and access to dangerous content, making 'Dangerous Information' the most relevant object.
The risk describes the impact of dangerous content, and this class directly addresses the adversary's actions and the resulting impact on AI systems and data.
